summary: Export evidence-bound SSOT proposals to a preserved Planfile review backlog

delivery.outcome: Export recomputed SSOT review proposals into an explicit external native Planfile backlog, with current source/artifact checks, stable dedupe, preservation of terminal and owned tasks, independent merge and isolated installed smoke.
nonGoals: No autonomous executor, source refactoring, standards adoption or remote synchronization
No CLI changes or global runtime replacement

architecture.decision: A bounded optional Planfile 0.1.126 adapter recomputes analyze_ssot from explicit observation/declarations, verifies live repositories and saved artifacts before and under the native mutation lock, and writes human review proposals only. Proposal identity binds source repository/component/domain/contract/finding and preserves terminal or externally owned records. This adds an adapter over the existing native Planfile schema, as ticket033 did; no persisted source data is migrated and no schema or data ownership is transferred.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert; preserve created review records and use explicit owner disposition.

validation.evidence: Source/artifact drift refusal, deterministic dedupe, ownership preservation, no execution or source mutation.
Full checks and exact-head protected independent review and merge.
Installed API creates and reuses explicit local human review backlog.
